classification.difficultyReason: Rectangle plus semicircle prism with no formula scaffold; exclude the internal join and combine arc and straight lengths.

content.prompt: Find the surface area of this composite prism to 2 d.p.

answer.worked:
The cross-section is a rectangle with a semicircle on top, so $r=6\div2=3\text{ m}$.
$$\begin{align*}
\text{Two ends}&=2\left(6\times2+\frac{\pi(3)^2}{2}\right)=24+9\pi\text{ m}^2\\
\text{Two side walls}&=2(2\times8)=32\text{ m}^2\\
\text{Bottom}&=6\times8=48\text{ m}^2\\
\text{Curved surface}&=\frac12\times2\pi(3)(8)=24\pi\text{ m}^2\\
\text{Total surface area}&=24+9\pi+32+48+24\pi\\
&=104+33\pi\\
&\approx207.67\text{ m}^2
\end{align*}$$
The join between the rectangle and the semicircle is inside the solid, so it is excluded.
